item.title: Korea Food Industry Association, Korea Technology Finance Corporation, and Nonghyup Bank Sign "Business Agreement on Financial Support for Food Tech Companies for Global Expansion of K-Food" (한국식품산업협회-기술보증기금-농협은행, ｢K-푸드 글로벌 확산을 위한 푸드테크 기업 금융지원 업무협약｣)
item.description:
The Korea Food Industry Association (Chairman Park Jin-sun, hereinafter referred to as the Association) signed a "Business Agreement on Financial Support for Food Tech Companies for Global Expansion of K-Food" with the Korea Technology Finance Corporation (Chairman Kim Jong-ho, hereinafter referred to as KOTEC) and Nonghyup Bank Co., Ltd. (Bank President Kang Tae-young, hereinafter referred to as Nonghyup) at 2:00 PM on Monday, July 6, in the Association's main conference room (2nd floor). (한국식품산업협회(회장 박진선, 이하 협회)는 7월 6일(월) 오후 두시 한국식품산업협회 대회의실(2층)에서 기술보증기금(이사장 김종호, 이하 기보)와 농협은행 주식회사(은행장 강태영, 이하 농협)과 함께 ｢K-푸드 글로벌 확산을 위한 푸드테크 기업 금융지원 업무협약｣을 체결했다.)

This agreement was established to lower the financial burden on food tech companies developing new products and technologies and to support smooth funding, in order to leverage the globally spreading K-Food craze into industrial competitiveness. (이번 협약은 전 세계로 확산되고 있는 K-푸드 열풍을 산업경쟁력으로 이어가기 위해 신제품 및 신기술을 개발하는 푸드테크 기업의 금융비용 부담을 낮추고 원활한 자금조달 지원을 위해 마련되었다.)

Under the agreement, the Association will identify food tech member companies in need of funding and recommend them to Nonghyup. Nonghyup will then select companies eligible for credit extension and recommend them to KOTEC, which provides technology guarantees, operating in a three-stage collaborative system. (협약에 따라 협회가 자금조달이 필요한 푸드테크 회원사를 발굴해 농협에 추천하면, 농협은 여신취급 가능 기업을 선별해 기보에 추천하고, 기보는 기술보증을 지원하는 3단계 협업 체계로 운영된다.)

The support program totals 177 billion Korean won and consists of ▲Special Contribution Agreement Guarantees (70 billion won, for working capital, up to 3 billion won per company, with a 100% guarantee ratio and a 0.2 percentage point reduction in guarantee fees for three years) and ▲Guarantee Fee Support Agreement Guarantees (107 billion won, for working and facility funds, with a 0.7 percentage point support for guarantee fees for two years). (지원 프로그램은 총 1,770억 원 규모이며 ▲특별출연 협약보증(700억 원, 운전자금, 기업당 30억 원 한도, 3년간 보증비율 100%·보증료 0.2% 포인트 감면) ▲보증료지원 협약보증(1,070억 원, 운전·시설자금, 2년간 보증료 0.7% 포인트 지원)으로 구성된다.)

Eligible companies are small and medium-sized enterprises engaged in new technology businesses or companies with total assets under 500 billion won, recommended by the Korea Food Industry Association, that meet KOTEC's technology guarantee requirements. (지원 대상은 신기술사업을 영위하는 중소기업 또는 총자산 5천억 원 미만 기업 중 기보의 기술보증 요건을 충족하는 한국식품산업협회 추천 푸드테크 기업이다.)

Vice Chairman Jeong Yong-ik of the Korea Food Industry Association stated, "Through this agreement, we expect food tech companies with excellent technological capabilities to reduce their funding burden and focus on technology development and global market expansion." He added, "We will continue to expand cooperation with related organizations to strengthen the competitiveness of the K-Food industry." (한국식품산업협회 정용익 부회장은 "이번 협약을 통해 우수한 기술력을 보유한 식품 푸드테크 기업들이 자금조달 부담을 줄이고 기술개발과 글로벌 시장 진출에 집중할 수 있을 것으로 기대한다."며 "앞으로도 K-푸드 산업 경쟁력 강화를 위해 유관기관과 협력을 확대해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: KOSPI Triggers 'Sell Sidecar'…Plunges Over 5% to 7500 Level (코스피, ‘매도 사이드카’ 발동…5%대 급락 7500선)
item.description:
The KOSPI plunged during morning trading on the 7th, triggering a temporary halt on program sell orders (sell sidecar). (코스피가 7일 오전 거래 중 급락하면서 프로그램매도호가 일시효력정지(매도 사이드카)가 발동했다.)

At 10:23 a.m. that day, the sharp decline in the KOSPI 200 futures index resulted in a five-minute suspension of program sell orders in the KOSPI market. At the time of the trigger, the KOSPI 200 futures index stood at 1227.32, down 66.26 points (5.12%) from the previous day's close. In the KOSPI market, a sell sidecar is activated when the KOSPI 200 futures index falls by more than 5% and persists for one minute. (이날 오전 10시23분 코스피200선물지수의 급락으로 유가증권시장의 프로그램매도호가 효력이 5분간 정지됐다. 발동 시점 당시 코스피200선물지수는 전일 종가보다 66.26포인트(5.12%) 내린 1227.32였다. 유가증권시장에서 매도 사이드카는 코스피200선물 지수가 5% 이상 하락해 1분간 지속되는 경우 발동된다.)

As of 10:29 a.m., the KOSPI was trading at 7597.93, plunging over 5% and breaking below the 8000 mark. The index started the day at 7919.20, down 132.13 points (1.64%) from the previous session, and widened its losses. (코스피는 오전 10시29분 현재 5% 넘게 급락한 채 8000선을 이탈해 7597.93에 거래되고 있다. 이날 지수는 전날 대비 132.13포인트(1.64%) 내린 7919.20으로 출발해 하락폭을 키웠다.)

Samsung Electronics, which reported record-breaking quarterly earnings that day, is experiencing a sharp decline of around 6%. SK Hynix's stock price is also showing a significant drop of about 5%. (이날 역대급 분기 실적을 발표한 삼성전자는 6%대의 급락세를 기록 중이다. 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 주가도 5%대로 큰 폭의 하락세를 나타내고 있다.)

item.title: Fair Trade Commission Imposes 740 Billion Won Fines on Four Starch Syrup Manufacturers… "Passing on Cost Hikes" (공정위, 전분당 제조 4사에 과징금 7400억원…“원가 인상 부담 떠넘겨”)
item.description:
The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) has imposed fines totaling 740 billion won on four companies that colluded on the prices of starch and starch syrup for over seven years. (공정거래위원회가 7년 넘게 전분 및 전분당 가격을 담합한 4개 업체에 7400억원의 과징금을 부과했다.)

On the 7th, the FTC announced it would levy a combined 747.6 billion won in fines on four manufacturers and sellers of starch and starch syrup. It also issued corrective orders, including a directive for each company to independently reset prices to appropriate levels, undoing the collusion-driven pricing. (공정위는 7일 4개 전분 및 전분당 제조·판매 사업자에 과징금 총 7476억원을 부과한다고 밝혔다. 담합으로 형성된 가격을 각 기업이 적정한 수준으로 다시 정하도록 하는 독자적 가격 재결정 명령 등 시정명령도 내렸다.)

The fines per company are as follows: Daesang 234.141 billion won, Samsyangsa 210.34 billion won, Sajo CPK 200.132 billion won, and CJ CheilJedang 102.965 billion won. These companies hold a 95.7% share of the domestic business-to-business (B2B) starch market and an 86.4% share of the starch syrup market. (업체별 과징금은 대상 2341억4100만원, 삼양사 2103억4000만원, 사조씨피케이(CPK) 2001억3200만원, 씨제이(CJ)제일제당 1029억6500만원 부과됐다. 이들 업체의 국내 기업 간 거래(B2B·비투비) 전분 시장에서 점유율은 95.7%, 전분당 시장에서 점유율은 86.4%에 달한다.)

Starch is used as a raw material in food products like confectionery and noodles, depending on its purpose, or as a raw material in industries such as paper manufacturing and steel. Starch syrup refers to items like corn syrup, glucose, and fructose, primarily made from corn starch. (전분은 용도에 따라 제과, 제면 등 식품의 원료로 쓰이거나 제지·철강 등 산업에서 원재료로 사용된다. 전분당은 옥수수 전분을 주원료로 하는 물엿, 포도당, 과당 등을 말한다.)

According to the FTC's investigation, from May 2018 to October 2025, the four companies colluded 13 times to agree on the timing and magnitude of price increases (8 times) and decreases (5 times) for starch and starch syrup applied to transactions between businesses, including food companies, paper manufacturers, and steelmakers. Notably, the investigation found that when major buyers demanded price cuts due to lower corn raw material costs, the companies reduced prices for them, while maintaining prices as much as possible for smaller buyers and dealers. The companies were also found to have specifically agreed on the content and timing of official documents sent to customers regarding price changes, and even visited each other's offices to confirm the documents' content and dispatch. (공정위 조사 결과, 4개 업체는 2018년 5월부터 2025년 10월까지 13차례에 걸쳐 식품업체, 제지사, 철강사 등 사업자 간 거래에 적용되는 전분 및 전분당 가격의 인상(8차례)·인하(5차례) 폭과 시기 등을 합의하고 실행한 것으로 나타났다. 특히 원재료인 옥수수 가격 인하에 따라 판매 가격 인하를 요구하는 대형 실수요처에는 가격을 인하하고, 소규모 실수요처, 대리점 등에는 최대한 판매 가격을 유지한 것으로 조사됐다. 업체들은 판매 가격 변경 근거 등 거래처에 보내는 공문 내용과 발송 시기 등을 구체적으로 합의하고, 서로 회사에 방문해 공문 내용과 발송 여부 등을 확인하기도 한 것으로 드러났다.)

The FTC determined that the companies colluded to maximize undue profits by passing on the burden of cost fluctuations from events like COVID-19 and the Russia-Ukraine war to their transaction counterparts, despite receiving government support such as tariff rate quotas. Corn accounts for 60-70% of the manufacturing costs of starch and starch syrup, and the four companies jointly import corn. Since April 2021, the government has applied a 0% tariff rate quota on approximately 2 million tons of corn for processing annually. (공정위는 업체들이 할당관세 등 정부 지원을 받고도 코로나19, 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 등에 따른 원가 변동 부담을 거래상대방에게 전가해 부당이득을 극대화하기 위해 짬짜미했다고 판단했다. 전분 및 전분당은 옥수수 가격이 제조원가의 60∼70%를 차지하고, 4개 업체는 옥수수를 공동으로 수입하고 있다. 정부는 2021년 4월부터 매해 2백만t가량의 가공용 옥수수에 대해 할당관세(가격 안정 등을 위해 특정 수입물품의 관세율을 낮춰주는 제도) 0%를 적용해주고 있다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, the FTC's secretariat announced that it had sent a review report containing sanctions recommendations, including fines, to the companies regarding bid-rigging and byproduct price-fixing cases involving starch and starch syrup, initiating the deliberation process. All four companies face bid-rigging allegations, while three—excluding CJ CheilJedang—face byproduct price-fixing allegations. Byproducts of starch and starch syrup are used in livestock feed or as raw materials for cooking oil. The FTC estimated the sales volume related to bid-rigging at 940 billion won and that related to byproduct price-fixing at 1.55 trillion won. Depending on the commission's deliberation, fines of up to 20% of the relevant sales volume could be imposed. (한편 공정위 사무처는 이날 전분·전분당 입찰담합 및 부산물 가격담합 사건에 대해 과징금 부과 등 제재 의견을 담은 심사보고서를 업체들에 송부해 심의 절차가 개시됐다고 밝혔다. 입찰담합 혐의는 4개 업체 모두, 부산물 가격담합 혐의는 씨제이제일제당을 제외한 3개 업체가 받는다. 전분 및 전분당 부산물은 가축용 사료나 식용유의 원료 등으로 사용된다. 공정위는 입찰담합 관련 매출액은 9400억원, 부산물 담합 관련 매출액은 1조5500억원에 이르는 것으로 산정했다. 위원회 심의에 따라 관련 매출액의 최대 20%까지 과징금을 부과할 수 있다.)

item.title: 10.3 Trillion Won in Unclaimed Insurance Money… Insurance Industry Launches Search for Owners (잠자는 보험금 10조3천억…보험업계, 주인 찾기 나선다)
item.description:
The Financial Services Commission and the insurance industry are set to begin a search for the owners of approximately 10 trillion won in 'hidden insurance money.' (금융위원회와 보험업계가 약 10조원 규모의 ‘숨은 보험금’ 주인 찾기에 나선다.)

On the 7th, the Financial Services Commission announced that starting this month, the insurance industry will verify the latest addresses of policyholders and beneficiaries eligible to claim hidden insurance money and notify them of the occurrence of insurance payouts and how to claim them. As of the end of last year, unclaimed hidden insurance money amounted to 10.3 trillion won. (7일 금융위는 보험업계가 이달부터 숨은 보험금을 찾아갈 보험계약자와 보험수익자 등의 최신 주소를 확인해 보험금 발생 사실과 청구 방법을 안내한다고 밝혔다. 지난해 말 기준 찾아가지 않은 숨은 보험금은 10조3천억원에 이른다.)

Hidden insurance money typically arises when insurance payouts are confirmed but policyholders are unaware of the payout due to changes in their address or contact information. Additionally, when a policy matures, the agreed-upon interest rate drops significantly—falling to 0% after three years—yet some people fail to claim the money because they mistakenly believe interest continues to accrue. Such cases are also classified as hidden insurance money. The interest rate applied after a policy matures generally decreases to 50% of the average disclosed rate for the first year, 40% from one to three years, and 0% after three years. (숨은 보험금은 보험금 지급이 확정됐으나 계약자의 주소나 연락처 등이 변경돼 보험금 발생 사실을 모르는 때 주로 발생한다. 또 보험계약이 만기에 이르면 약정 이자율이 대폭 감소해 3년 후에는 0%로 떨어지는데도, 이런 사실을 모르고 이자가 계속 쌓인다고 여겨 보험금을 찾지 않는 경우도 숨은 보험금으로 분류된다. 보험계약 만기 뒤 적용 이자율은 통상 1년까지 평균공시이율의 50%, 1년 초과∼3년까지 40%로 낮아지고, 3년 뒤에는 0%가 된다.)

Among the hidden insurance money, interim insurance payouts are the largest, amounting to 7.7667 trillion won. Maturity insurance payouts total 1.9235 trillion won, and dormant insurance payouts amount to 623.7 billion won. Interim insurance payouts refer to cases where policyholders fail to receive various diagnostic benefits, congratulations bonuses, or dividends that occur during the policy period without being aware. Maturity insurance payouts are those not claimed after the policy ends. Dormant insurance payouts occur when more than three years have passed since the reason for the payout arose, and the insurance company or the Korea Inclusive Finance Agency holds the funds virtually without interest. (숨은 보험금 가운데 중도보험금이 7조7667억원으로 가장 많다. 만기보험금은 1조9235억원, 휴면보험금은 6237억원이다. 중도보험금은 보험계약 기간이 계속되는 가운데 각종 진단금·축하금·배당금 등이 발생한 사실을 모르고 수령하지 않는 경우를 뜻한다. 만기보험금은 만기 도래 뒤 찾아가지 않는 경우다. 휴면보험금은 보험금 지급사유 발생 뒤 3년이 지나고 보험회사나 서민금융진흥원이 사실상 무이자로 보관하고 있는 경우다.)

The Financial Services Commission reported that last year, it paid out 3.247 trillion won (800,000 cases) in hidden insurance money to policyholders and others. The average payout per claim is approximately 4.04 million won. Whether one holds hidden insurance money can be checked by visiting the 'Find My Insurance' website (cont.insure.or.kr) via mobile or PC. (금융위는 지난해 숨은 보험금 3조2470억원(80만건)을 계약자 등에게 지급했다고 밝혔다. 청구 1건당 평균 지급액은 약 404만원이다. 숨은 보험금 보유 여부는 모바일이나 피시(PC)로 ‘내보험찾아줌’ 누리집(cont.insure.or.kr)에 방문해 조회할 수 있다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Malatang and AI Subscription Fees Included in CPI…Kindergarten Tuition and USB Removed (마라탕·AI 구독료, 소비자물가지수 포함된다…유치원납입금·USB는 빠져)
item.description:
Smartwatches and malatang will be added to the consumer price index (CPI), which is revised every five years. With the rise of paid artificial intelligence (AI) subscriptions, related items will be newly established, and as free childcare expands, kindergarten tuition will be excluded from the index. (5년마다 개편하는 소비자물가지수에 스마트워치, 마라탕 등이 추가된다. 인공지능(AI) 유료 구독이 늘면서 관련 항목이 신설되고, 무상보육이 확대되면서 유치원 납입금은 항목에서 제외하기로 했다.)

The National Data Agency announced a provisional revision plan for the 2025-based CPI on the 7th, containing these details. The agency adjusts the “representative items” (goods and services whose prices are surveyed) every five years to reflect changes in the economic and social structure and consumption patterns, and changes the “weights,” which quantify the importance of household expenditures, every two to three years. (국가데이터처는 이러한 내용을 담은 2025년 기준 소비자물가지수 잠정 개편안을 7일 발표했다. 데이터처는 5년마다 경제·사회구조 및 소비패턴 변화를 반영해 ‘대표품목’(가격을 조사하는 상품과 서비스)을 조정하고, 2~3년마다 가계 지출에서 차지하는 중요도를 수치화한 ‘가중치’를 변경한다.)

Under this revision plan, the number of representative items has been reduced to 455, down three from the 458 in 2020. First, smartwatches and electric vehicle charging fees, which have seen increased usage, have been newly included in the survey. Software subscription fees, including AI subscription fees, and online shopping subscription fees have been newly established, and cloud storage usage fees have also been newly added. On the other hand, storage device items have been excluded due to the decline in use of physical USBs. The agency explained, “We have enhanced the real-world feel of the price index by reflecting people’s digital lives, including the use of AI.” With the increase in free childcare and education, kindergarten tuition, school supplementary education fees, childcare facility usage fees, and art supplies have been excluded, while infant and toddler class fees have been newly added. (이번 개편안에서 대표품목은 2020년(458개)보다 3개 감소한 455개로 추려졌다. 우선 이용이 증가한 스마트워치, 전기차충전료가 조사 대상으로 새롭게 편입됐다. 인공지능 구독료가 포함된 소프트웨어구독료와 온라인쇼핑구독료가 신설됐고, 클라우드저장공간이용료도 새로 들어갔다. 반면 실물 유에스비(USB) 사용이 줄면서 저장장치 품목은 제외됐다. 데이터처는 “인공지능 활용 등 국민의 디지털 라이프를 반영해 물가지수의 현실 체감도를 높였다”고 설명했다. 무상보육·교육이 늘면서 유치원납입금, 학교보충교육비, 보육시설이용료, 회화용구도 제외됐고, 영유아강습료는 새로 추가됐다.)

The weights have also been adjusted to reflect changes in spending structure. “Housing, water, electricity, and fuel,” with the highest weight in the total index (1000), has been raised to 181.2, up 9.6 from three years ago. According to the agency’s explanation, the relative importance has increased due to rising housing rent and others. “Transportation and shipping” has decreased by 6.3 to 104.4. An agency official stated, “Although oil prices have been high recently, oil prices were relatively stable in 2025 (the base point of revision), and the share of petroleum-related spending in households has shrunk as electric and hybrid vehicle adoption has grown.” (가중치도 지출구조 변화를 고려해 조정됐다. 총지수(1000) 중 가중치가 가장 높은 ‘주택, 수도, 전기 및 연료’는 3년 전보다 9.6 상승한 181.2로 상향됐다. 주택 임대료 등이 오르면서 상대적 중요도도 커졌다는 게 데이터처의 설명이다. ‘교통 및 운송’은 6.3 줄어든 104.4로 나타났는데, 데이터처 관계자는 “최근엔 석유 가격이 높지만 (개편 기준 시점인) 2025년에는 유가가 비교적 안정됐었고, 전기차나 하이브리드차 보급이 늘면서 가계에서 차지하는 석유류 지출 비중이 작아졌다”고 말했다.)

This revision plan also reflects changes in the nation’s eating habits. Malatang and salads, with increased dining-out consumption, have been newly included in the survey items, and pork has been separated into domestic and imported categories. Additionally, meal kits and assembly-type storage furniture have been added, while items with low monthly average consumption or that are difficult to survey, such as peanuts, bellflower roots, bracken, butane gas, sinks, dehumidifiers, black boxes, and lunch boxes, have been excluded. The current electric-powered vehicles will be divided into hybrid passenger cars and electric passenger cars, and online content usage fees will be split into online game usage fees and streaming service usage fees for separate surveys. Kimchi stew with rice and soybean paste stew with rice will be consolidated into stew with rice, and bath fees and sauna fees will be consolidated into bath fees. (이번 개편안에는 국민 식습관 변화도 담겼다. 외식 소비가 증가한 마라탕과 샐러드가 새로 조사항목에 편입됐고, 돼지고기는 국산과 수입으로 항목을 분리했다. 이 밖에도 밀키트, 조립식수납가구가 추가되고 월평균 소비가 적거나 조사가 어려운 땅콩, 도라지, 고사리, 부탄가스, 싱크대, 습기제거제, 블랙박스, 도시락은 제외됐다. 현행 전기동력차는 하이브리드승용차와 전기승용차로 나누고, 온라인콘텐츠이용료도 온라인게임이용료, 스트리밍서비스이용료로 분리해서 조사할 예정이다. 김치찌개백반과 된장찌개백반은 찌개백반으로, 목욕료와 찜질방이용료는 목욕료로 통합한다.)

The agency stated, “This draft of representative item selection will be finalized after collecting public opinions until the 17th,” and “The results of the revision will be announced on December 18th, and new standard CPI trends will be published on December 31st.” (데이터처는 “이번 대표품목 선정안은 오는 17일까지 국민 의견을 수렴한 뒤 최종 확정될 예정”이라며 “개편 결과는 12월18일 발표되며, 12월31일에는 새로운 기준의 소비자물가동향을 공표할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Shin Min-jeong, Reporter shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Multi-homeowner hit with 1 billion won tax bill after using fake property transfer for single-home exemption (허위 명의이전 ‘1주택 비과세’ 받은 다주택자에 10억 추징)
item.description:
Mr. A, who owned two homes, formally transferred a low-value apartment to an acquaintance of his mother, then sold a high-value apartment to a third party for 2 billion won, claiming the one-household-one-home exemption when filing his capital gains tax. Even after transferring the title, Mr. A continued to live in the low-value apartment and paid the acquisition tax and property tax for the acquaintance. The National Tax Service also found that Mr. A paid tens of thousands of won each month as a kickback to the acquaintance for cooperating in tax evasion, until the title to the low-value apartment was transferred back. The tax agency deemed this a sham sale using an improper title trust, levied 1 billion won in capital gains tax, and referred Mr. A, his mother who led the transaction, and the acquaintance who lent their name to the prosecution for tax evasion. <<> On the 7th, the National Tax Service announced that, through tax investigations into real estate transactions including ultra-high-value apartments as in Mr. A’s case, it had identified a total of 73.1 billion won in evaded taxes. The tax agency began a simultaneous investigation into 104 individuals suspected of real estate tax evasion on October 1 last year and has so far collected 31.8 billion won. The tax agency explained that out of the 104 individuals under investigation, tax evasion was confirmed in about 80 cases, excluding those whose sources of funds were clearly explained. <<> During the investigation, the tax agency said it uncovered about 40 cases where, like Mr. A, individuals unjustly applied the one-household-one-home exemption through sham sales to avoid capital gains tax. It also reported discovering various other types of cases, including improper gifts, corporate fund outflows, and inheritance tax evasion using foreign names. <<> Among those under investigation, 6 individuals confirmed to have committed fraudulent acts under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act were referred to the prosecution, while 4 received a summary disposition equivalent to a fine of 700 million won. 20 individuals found to have violated the Act on Real Estate Real Name Registration, such as through title trusts, were reported to the relevant local governments. <<> Oh Sang-hoon, head of the Asset Taxation Bureau at the National Tax Service, stated, “In preparation for the potential increase in gift transactions following the re-imposition of heavy taxation on multi-homeowners, we will intensively verify whether improper gifts are taking place and continue to examine low-price transfers among family members or disguised sales.” <<> Reporter Park Su-ji suji@hani.co.kr (집 두채를 보유한 ㄱ씨는 어머니 지인에게 저가 아파트를 형식적으로 넘긴 뒤, 이후 고가 아파트를 제3자에게 20억원에 양도하면서 1세대1주택 비과세를 적용해 양도세를 신고했다. ㄱ씨는 명의를 넘긴 뒤에도 해당 저가 아파트에 계속 거주했고, 지인에게 취득세·재산세를 대납해줬다. 저가 아파트 명의를 다시 돌려받기까지 탈세에 협조한 대가로 매달 수십만원의 사례금까지 지급한 사실도 국세청에 포착됐다. 국세청은 이를 부당한 명의신탁을 이용한 가장매매로 판단해 10억원의 양도소득세를 추징하고, ㄱ씨와 거래를 주도한 어머니, 명의를 빌려준 지인까지 조세포탈범으로 검찰에 고발했다.)

item.title: Q1 Corporate Surplus Funds Hit Record High of 20.8 Trillion Won Amid Semiconductor Boom… Household Surplus Also Rises Sharply (반도체 호황에 1분기 기업 여유자금 20.8조 역대 최고…가계도 대폭 증가)
item.description:
South Korean companies' surplus funds exceeded 20 trillion won in the first quarter of this year, reaching an all-time high. This is attributed to a sharp increase in operating profits driven by improved corporate performance, particularly centered on the semiconductor super-boom. (올해 1분기 국내 기업들의 여유자금이 20조원을 웃돌며 역대 최고치를 기록한 것으로 나타났다. 반도체 초호황 중심의 기업 실적 호전으로 영업이익이 대폭 늘어난 데 따른 결과로 풀이된다.)

According to the Bank of Korea's "Q1 Flow of Funds (Preliminary)" statistics released on the 7th, the net financial investment of the domestic sector amounted to 84.3 trillion won, significantly expanding from the previous quarter (51.9 trillion won). Net financial investment refers to surplus funds, calculated as financial asset transactions (fund investment) minus financial liability transactions (fundraising). (한국은행이 7일 내놓은 ‘1분기 자금순환(잠정)’ 통계를 보면, 국내 부문의 순자금운용 규모는 84조3천억원으로 전 분기(51조9천억원)에 견줘 크게 확대됐다. 순자금운용은 금융자산 거래액(자금운용)에서 금융부채 거래액(자금조달)을 뺀 값으로 여유자금을 뜻한다.)

Among domestic sectors, the net financial investment of corporations (non-financial entities) stood at 20.8 trillion won, a sharp increase from the previous quarter (100 billion won), setting a record high since the statistics were first compiled in 2009. The previous record was 5.8 trillion won in the first quarter of 2024. The real sector (non-financial entities) typically engages in fundraising, often recording negative net financial investment. The Bank of Korea analyzed this as "due to a surge in corporate net profits." In Q1 of this year, sales of listed companies on the Korea Exchange increased by 22.0% compared to the previous quarter, with net profits reaching 111.4 trillion won. In the previous quarter, these figures were -2.7% and around 22 trillion won, respectively. (국내 부문 중 기업(비금융법인)의 순자금운용 규모는 20조8천억원으로 전 분기(1천억원) 대비 대폭 늘어 2009년 통계 편제 이후 최고치를 기록했다. 기존 최고치는 2024년 1분기의 5조8천억원이었다. 실물부문(비금융법인)은 대개 자금조달을 하는 쪽이어서 순자금 운용에서 마이너스(–)를 기록하는 수가 많다. 한은은 “기업의 순이익이 급증한 데 따른 것”으로 분석했다. 올 1분기 한국거래소 상장기업 매출액은 전분기 대비 22.0% 증가했으며, 순이익 규모는 111조4천억원에 이르렀다. 전 분기에는 이 수치가 각각 -2.7%, 22조원 수준이었다.)

Household surplus funds also saw a substantial increase. The net financial investment of households and non-profit institutions serving households (NPISH) amounted to 79.2 trillion won, expanding from the previous quarter (67 trillion won). This is close to the all-time high of 88 trillion won recorded in the first quarter of last year. This was attributed to increased household income from year-end bonuses and a rise in surplus funds due to a decrease in the volume of new apartment move-ins. In Q1 of this year, the growth rate of households' total disposable income was 4.5% quarter-on-quarter, while the number of new apartment move-ins was 50,000 units. In Q4 of last year, these figures were 3.2% and 64,000 units, respectively. (가계 여유자금도 큰 폭으로 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 가계 및 비영리단체의 순자금운용 규모는 79조2천억원으로 전 분기(67조원)보다 확대됐다. 역대 최고치였던 지난해 1분기 88조원에 버금가는 수준이다. 이는 연초 상여금 유입으로 가계 소득이 늘고, 아파트 신규입주 물량 감소로 여유 자금이 증가한 데 따른 결과로 분석됐다. 올해 1분기 가계 총처분가능소득 증가율은 전 분기 대비 4.5%, 아파트 신규 입주 물량은 5만호였다. 지난해 4분기에는 각각 3.2%, 6만4천호였다.)

Fund investment by households and NPISH increased mainly in equity securities, investment funds, and deposits at financial institutions, while fundraising decreased primarily in borrowings from financial institutions. The volume of equity securities and investment funds expanded to 61.4 trillion won, nearly double the previous quarter (34 trillion won). (가계 및 비영리단체의 자금운용은 지분증권 및 투자펀드, 금융기관 예치금을 중심으로 늘었고, 자금조달 쪽을 보면 금융기관 차입금을 중심으로 줄었다. 지분증권 및 투자펀드 규모는 61조4천억원으로 전 분기(34조원)의 두배에 가깝게 불어났다.)

As of the end of Q1, the financial assets of households and NPISH stood at 6,417.1 trillion won, an increase of 209.4 trillion won from the end of the previous quarter, while financial liabilities totaled 2,466.8 trillion won, up by 26 trillion won. Consequently, net financial assets rose by 183.5 trillion won from the end of the previous quarter to 3,950.2 trillion won, and the ratio of financial assets to liabilities increased from 2.54 times at the end of the previous quarter to 2.60 times. (가계 및 비영리단체의 금융자산은 1분기 말 기준 6417조1천억원으로 전 분기 말에 견줘 209조4천억원 늘었으며, 금융부채는 2466조8천억원으로 26조원 증가했다. 이에 따라 순금융자산은 전분기 말보다 183조5천억원 늘어난 3950조2천억원, 부채 대비 금융자산 비율은 전분기말 2.54배에서 2.60배로 높아졌다.)

For the general government (central and local governments and non-profit public institutions), net fundraising amounted to 23.3 trillion won, up from the previous quarter (19 trillion won), as government spending exceeded revenue due to the rapid execution of the fiscal budget. (일반정부(중앙·지방정부 및 비영리공공기관)는 재정 신속집행으로 정부 지출이 수입을 웃돌면서 순자금 조달 규모가 23조3천억원으로 전 분기(19조원)보다 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.)

In the external sector, net fundraising surged to 84.3 trillion won from 51.9 trillion won in the previous quarter, setting a record high since the statistics began. The previous record was 53.3 trillion won in Q3 of last year. An increase in the external sector's fund investment indicates a rise in South Korea's external liabilities, while an increase in fundraising signifies a growth in external assets. (국외 부문을 보면, 순자금 조달 규모가 84조3천억원으로 전 분기(51조9천억원)에 견줘 큰 폭으로 늘어 통계 편제 이후 최고치를 기록했다. 기존 최고는 지난해 3분기의 53조3천억원이었다. 국외 부문의 자금운용 증가는 우리나라의 대외부채 증가를, 자금조달 증가는 대외자산 증가를 의미한다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Canada Submarine Order Lost…‘K-Defense’ Must Not Be Complacent, Need to Build Supply Chain Strategy (캐나다 잠수함 수주 실패…‘K방산’ 자만 말고, 공급망 전략 구축 필요)
item.description:
On December 31 last year, the ROK Navy’s first submarine, the ROKS Chang Bogo (1,200-ton class), was decommissioned. This submarine, the lead ship of the Chang Bogo-class (1,200-ton class) commissioned in 1993, was built at the shipyard of the German submarine specialist company HDW at a time when domestic technology was virtually nonexistent. The second ship was assembled domestically by Daewoo Heavy Industries using German designs and components, while performance improvements for the third ship began with domestic technology. Subsequently, Daewoo Heavy Industries was acquired by Hanwha Ocean after transitioning through Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering, and HDW was acquired by the diesel submarine powerhouse ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) of Germany. Then, in 2026, the two companies were set to compete head-to-head with comparable technological prowess in Canada’s Conventional Powered Submarine Project (CPSP), valued at up to 60 trillion won. <<> On the 7th, just before the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, Canada, a NATO member, chose ‘Berlin,’ a core NATO ally, over ‘Seoul.’ This aligns with the prediction that announcing the preferred bidder before the NATO summit would favor Germany, while announcing it after the summit would favor South Korea. International diplomatic and security experts and the defense industry view this as a result of prioritizing the strategic judgment of the NATO alliance amid geopolitical crises, rather than submarine technological competitiveness. On the other hand, unlike South Korean ground weapons such as the K9 self-propelled howitzer and K2 Black Panther, which emphasize rapid delivery and cost-effectiveness, there are pointed observations about the clear lessons from the repeated failures to win orders for naval weapons, which are strategic assets where interoperability is key. The argument is that, rather than slogans like being one of the ‘four major defense powers,’ a sophisticated long-term strategy based on geopolitical interests and supply chain cohesion is needed. <<> The 3,600-ton ‘Chang Bogo-III Batch-II’ submarine proposed by Hanwha Ocean to Canada already has a predecessor model, the ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho (Chang Bogo-III Batch-I), in operation. From March to May last year, it sailed 14,000 km from Jinhae, South Gyeongsang Province, to Guam, Hawaii, and a Canadian naval base on the west coast, demonstrating not only long-range operational and submerged performance but also interoperability with the Canadian Navy, which is equipped with a NATO-based communication network. It overcomes the limitations of diesel submarines through advanced technologies like Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP) and lithium-ion batteries, enabling underwater operations for over three weeks without surfacing. The 3,000-ton Type 212CD submarine, jointly designed by ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems with the Norwegian defense company Kongsberg, which focuses on Arctic operations, also features AIP and lithium-ion batteries, along with next-generation combat system technology and stealth capabilities with a diamond-shaped hull. While its biggest strength is that TKMS has built over a third of NATO allied submarines, the Type 212CD is still in the design phase, leaving its performance unverified as a weakness. <<> On that day, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced the preferred bidder, stating, “The TKMS platform is optimized for operations in Arctic waters. It is fully interoperable with NATO, enabling seamless communication, information sharing, and joint mission execution.” This is an adherence to standardized NATO systems rather than the proven performance demonstrated by actual products. President Lee Jae-myung posted on Facebook that day: “Our submarines have competed proudly with global submarine powerhouses and proven their excellent performance and technological capabilities. Although we did not achieve the expected outcome in this Canadian submarine project, I am confident that today’s experience will serve as valuable fertilizer to further advance our technology and enhance our competitiveness.” <<> In November last year, Hanwha Ocean failed to win an order in Poland’s new submarine project, losing out to the Swedish company Saab. Shim Sun-hyung, head of the Defense Industry Research Team at the Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade, noted: “In the Canadian submarine project, NATO interoperability was decisive, and it cannot be said our Operational Capability Requirements (ROC) were inferior. On the other hand, the Polish submarine project has been assessed as having been ‘overspecced’ compared to the shallow depth of the Baltic Sea. Interoperability must be resolved by the government at the diplomatic level, while price-to-performance and ROC must be meticulously addressed by companies.” <<> After losing the 2024 Australian frigate project to a Japanese company backed by full government support, the Defense Acquisition Program Administration signed a business agreement forming the ‘K-Defense One Team,’ where Hanwha Ocean manages submarines and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries manages surface vessels. Although the first One Team was formed for the Canadian conventional submarine project, assessments indicate that the two companies engaged in overheated competition over domestic defense contracts, and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration failed to manage this properly, preventing synergy from being realized. <<> After being eliminated from the preferred bidder selection, Hanwha Ocean stated, “We devoted all our efforts to winning the order based on full government support, the outstanding performance of our submarines, and the Navy’s successful experience in operating submarines, but we could not overcome the wall of the NATO alliance. We will thoroughly analyze the challenges identified through this bidding competition, devise definitive alternatives, and surely find a path for ‘K-Maritime Defense’ to take a greater leap in the global market.” HD Hyundai Heavy Industries commented, “The experience of working as One Team for the bid will serve as a solid stepping stone for K-Defense to make a significant leap forward.” <<> Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (지난해 12월31일 우리 해군 최초 잠수함인 장보고함(1200톤급)이 퇴역했다. 1993년 취역한 장보고급(1200톤급) 1번함인 이 잠수함은, 당시 국내 기술이 전무한 상황에서 독일 잠수함 전문 기업 하데베(HDW) 조선소에서 건조됐다. 2번함은 대우중공업이 독일 설계와 부품을 들여와 국내 조립을, 3번함은 국내 기술로 성능 개량이 시작됐다. 이후 대우중공업은 대우조선해양을 거쳐 한화오션에 인수됐고, 하데베는 디젤 잠수함 강자인 독일 티센크루프마린시스템즈(TKMS)에 인수됐다. 그리고, 2026년 두 회사는 막상막하 기술력으로 최대 60조원에 달하는 캐나다 초계잠수함 사업(CPSP)에서 맞붙었다.)

item.title: Was the trademark royalty appropriate? Fair Trade Commission investigates CJ for internal transactions following Hanwha (상표권 사용료 적정했나…공정위, 한화 이어 CJ도 내부거래 여부 조사)
item.description:
The Fair Trade Commission has launched an on-site investigation to determine whether there were any unfair internal transactions in the trademark royalty dealings among affiliates of the CJ Group. (공정거래위원회가 씨제이(CJ)그룹 계열사 간 브랜드(상표권) 사용료 거래에서 부당한 내부거래가 있었는지 확인하기 위해 현장 조사에 나섰다.)

According to industry sources on the 7th, the FTC sent investigators to CJ Group’s headquarters in Jung-gu, Seoul, starting this morning, to secure data related to transactions between affiliates. (7일 업계에 따르면, 공정위는 이날 오전부터 서울 중구 소재 씨제이그룹 본사에 조사관을 보내 계열사 간 거래 등과 관련한 자료를 확보하고 있다.)

The FTC is reportedly examining whether CJ affiliates set appropriate royalty fees in the process of trading trademark rights and whether any unfair internal transactions occurred. (공정위는 씨제이 계열사가 상표권을 거래하는 과정에서 적정한 사용료를 책정했는지, 부당한 내부 거래가 있었는지 들여다보는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Trademark royalties are a type of fee paid by affiliates for using the “CJ” brand. They are typically calculated by applying a certain rate to sales after deducting advertising costs and similar expenses. (브랜드 사용료는 계열사들이 ‘씨제이’라는 상표를 사용하는 조건으로 지불하는 일종의 로열티다. 통상 매출액에서 광고 비용 등을 제외한 뒤 일정 요율을 적용해 계산한다.)

The FTC is reportedly reviewing whether the trademark royalties are calculated by properly reflecting industry-specific characteristics and the actual benefits gained from using the brand. (공정위는 브랜드 사용료가 업종별 특성과 실제 브랜드 사용으로 얻는 편익을 적절히 반영해 산정되고 있는지를 살펴보고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Receiving trademark royalties from affiliates by a holding company can be seen as a normal business practice. However, since the value of a trademark is difficult to assess objectively, it cannot be ruled out that this might be used as a roundabout way to transfer profits to the holding company, where the controlling family’s stake is high. (지주회사가 계열사로부터 상표권 사용료를 받는 것 자체는 통상적인 거래로 볼 수 있다. 다만 상표권 가치는 객관적으로 산정하기 어려운 측면이 있어, 총수 일가 지분율이 높은 지주회사로 계열사 이익을 이전하는 우회 수단으로 활용될 가능성도 배제하기 어렵다.)

Previously, on the 23rd of last month, the FTC conducted a similar on-site investigation of the Hanwha Group to verify comparable allegations. (앞서 지난달 23일 공정위는 비슷한 의혹을 확인하려고 한화그룹을 상대로도 현장 조사를 벌인 바 있다.)

By Park Su-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: LG Electronics Q2 Operating Profit Reaches 1.5788 Trillion Won… First Half Exceeds Last Year's Annual Figure (LG전자 2분기 영업이익 1조5788억원…상반기에 작년치 넘어)
item.description:
LG Electronics has posted preliminary record-high results for the second quarter. The expansion of premium home appliance sales and growth in the automotive electronics (electronic and electrical equipment) business are seen as driving revenue. (엘지(LG)전자가 2분기 기준으로 역대 최대 실적을 낸 것으로 잠정 집계됐다. 가전 프리미엄 판매 확대에 차량용 전장(전자·전기장비) 사업 성장세가 매출을 이끈 것으로 풀이된다.)

On a consolidated basis, LG Electronics announced on the 7th that it preliminarily recorded sales of 23.8297 trillion won and an operating profit of 1.5788 trillion won for the second quarter (April–June) of this year. Sales increased by 14.9% compared to the same period last year, and operating profit surged by 146.9%. However, compared to the previous quarter, sales rose by 0.4%, while operating profit decreased by 5.7%. (엘지전자는 연결 기준으로 올해 2분기(4~6월) 매출 23조8297억원, 영업이익 1조5788억원을 올린 것으로 잠정 집계됐다고 7일 공시했다. 매출은 전년 동기 대비 14.9%, 영업이익은 146.9% 늘었다. 다만, 직전 분기와 견주면 매출은 0.4% 늘었지만, 영업이익은 5.7% 감소한 것으로 집계됐다.)

The second-quarter operating profit exceeded the average consensus of 1.058 trillion won from securities firms, as compiled by financial data provider FnGuide. Both sales and operating profit are the highest ever for a second quarter. On a cumulative basis for the first half (January–June), sales stood at 47.5569 trillion won, and operating profit reached 3.2525 trillion won. The operating profit for the first half alone surpassed last year's full-year operating profit of 2.4784 trillion won. (2분기 영업이익은 금융정보업체인 에프앤가이드가 집계한 증권사들의 전망값(컨센서스)인 평균 1조580억원을 웃돈다. 매출과 영업이익 모두 역대 2분기 기준 최대치다. 상반기(1~2분기) 누적 기준으로 매출은 47조5569억원, 영업이익은 3조2525억원이다. 상반기 영업이익만으로도 지난해 연간 영업이익(2조4784억원)을 넘어섰다.)

These results are attributed to the expansion of premium product sales in LG Electronics' core businesses, including home appliances and TVs. Premium home appliance sales maintained a solid trend, and the growth of business-to-business (B2B) areas such as commercial washing machines and built-in appliances also contributed to performance improvement. Additionally, high-profit platform businesses, including the webOS smart TV operating system and appliance subscriptions, grew and boosted operating profit. The component business is also expanding its scope beyond home appliance parts like compressors and motors to include robot actuators. (이런 실적은 엘지전자의 주력 사업인 생활가전과 티브이(TV) 사업이 프리미엄 제품 판매 확대에 힘입은 결과로 풀이된다. 프리미엄 가전 판매도 견조한 흐름을 보였고, 상업용 세탁기와 빌트인 가전 등 기업 간 거래(비투비·B2B) 영역 확대도 실적 개선에 힘을 보탰다. 여기에 스마트 티브이(TV) 운영체제인 웹오에스(webOS)와 가전 구독 등 고수익 플랫폼 사업이 성장하며 영업이익에 기여했다. 부품 사업도 컴프레서(압축기), 모터 등 가전 부품뿐 아니라 로봇 액추에이터로 사업 영역을 넓히고 있다.)

The automotive electronics (VS) division is considered LG Electronics' future growth business. This is because it maintains stable growth based on a high order backlog, with major automakers such as Hyundai Motor and BMW as clients. The heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (ES) business unit also saw increased product sales, particularly in Europe, where a record heatwave persisted. (전장 부문(VS)은 엘지전자의 미래 성장 사업으로 꼽힌다. 현대차, 베엠베(BMW) 등 주요 완성차 업체를 고객사로 두고 높은 수주잔고를 바탕으로 안정적인 성장세를 이어가고 있기 때문이다. 냉난방 공조(ES) 사업부도 기록적인 폭염이 이어진 유럽을 중심으로 제품 판매가 늘었다.)

However, in the second half of the year, U.S. tariff policies are expected to become a variable. LG Electronics reflected tariff refunds paid on last year's export volumes to the U.S. as one-time income in this quarter's results. The company explains that even excluding the refund effect, profitability has significantly improved due to sales growth and enhanced cost competitiveness. LG Electronics disclosed its preliminary results on this day but did not release segment-specific performance. The company's full results will be announced at the end of this month. (다만, 하반기엔 미국 관세 정책이 변수가 될 전망이다. 엘지전자는 이번 분기 실적에 지난해 미국 수출 물량으로 납부한 관세 환급액을 일회성 수익으로 반영했다. 환급 효과를 제외하더라도 매출 증가와 원가 경쟁력 개선으로 수익성이 크게 개선됐다는 것이 회사 쪽 설명이다. 엘지전자는 이날 잠정 실적을 공시했지만 사업 부문별 실적은 따로 공개하지 않았다. 엘지전자의 본 실적은 이달 말 공개된다.)

item.title: Buying Spree Spreads to Redevelopment Villas Among 20s and 30s…Hitting 'Bottom' After Jeonse Fraud Crisis (재개발 빌라로 2030 매수세 번져…전세사기 사태 뒤 ‘저점’ 찍어)
item.description:
Recently, the buying spree among people in their 20s and 30s, which has driven up prices of mid- to low-priced apartments in Seoul, is spreading to non-apartment housing. As apartment sale prices soar and the jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rent crisis deepens, the cash-strapped 2030 generation appears to be turning to investments in redevelopment villas. (최근 서울 내 중저가 아파트의 상승장을 이끌어온 20∼30대의 매수세가 비아파트로도 퍼지고 있다. 아파트 매매가격이 가파르게 오르는 가운데 전월세난까지 심화하면서 자금력이 부족한 2030세대가 재개발 빌라 투자에까지 나서고 있는 것으로 보인다.)

An analysis of data from the Korea Real Estate Board on the 7th shows that the number of non-apartment transactions in Seoul reached 5,224 in April and 5,199 in May, surpassing 5,000 for two consecutive months. This is the first time non-apartment transactions in Seoul have exceeded 5,000 since May 2022 (5,292 cases), about four years ago. The non-apartment market, which saw monthly transactions exceed 10,000 cases as recently as 2020, shrank significantly after the jeonse fraud crisis in 2022. After hitting a low of 1,480 transactions in January 2023, it has been gradually recovering. The sale prices of non-apartments (row houses) in Seoul have also risen by a cumulative 3.37% (as of May) this year, showing an increase nearly six times the cumulative growth rate (0.59%) observed in May last year. <<> A notable trend in recent non-apartment transactions is the rising share of purchases by the 2030 generation. The proportion of non-apartment purchases in Seoul by those in their 20s and 30s hovered in the 20% range from December 2023 (30.8%) until recovering to 30% in October last year (31.7%). It has since shown high proportions of 35.4% in April and 34.4% in May. Along with the recovery in non-apartment transactions, the buying power of the 2030 generation has strengthened. <<> Market observers believe that non-apartments, particularly villas in the early stages of redevelopment, are attracting the attention of the 2030 generation. Dr. Kim Je-kyung of Toomee Real Estate Consulting said, “As apartment prices in Seoul rise too steeply, prices are consistently climbing, especially for villas with redevelopment potential. Redevelopment investment is inherently complex and difficult to access, but it’s a notable recent phenomenon that young people are showing interest in redevelopment and directly jumping into such investments.” <<> Indeed, an examination of areas where the 2030 buying spree is concentrated clearly reveals demand for ‘redevelopment investment.’ The highest proportion of non-apartment purchases by the 2030 generation is in Yongsan District (52.2%), where urban regeneration-type redevelopment projects connected to the Yongsan International Business District and Hannam New Town are progressing successively. This is followed by Seongdong District (48.5%), Gangnam District (43.3%), Yeongdeungpo District (41.5%), Dongjak District (41.0%), and Seocho District (40.7%). These areas also have high market expectations for redevelopment projects. <<> Experts point out that since redevelopment projects are not infrequently prolonged or abandoned, investment caution is necessary. Nam Hyeok-woo of Woori Bank's Real Estate Research Institute said, “It’s true that demand is operating among young people eager to pre-empt non-apartments with redevelopment potential, even with limited budgets. However, in the early stages of redevelopment, cases where projects drift—such as when zoning designations are canceled—are not rare, so one must recognize it as a highly risky investment tool.” <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (7일 한국부동산원 자료를 분석해보면, 서울 비아파트 거래건수는 지난 4월 5224건, 5월 5199건으로 2개월 연속 5천건을 넘어섰다. 서울 비아파트 거래건수가 5천건을 넘어선 건 2022년 5월(5292건) 이후 약 4년 만이다. 2020년만 해도 월 거래건수가 1만건을 넘기도 했던 비아파트 시장은 2022년 전세사기 사태로 인해 크게 움츠러들었고, 2023년 1월(1480건) 저점을 찍은 뒤 단계적으로 회복하는 중이다. 서울 비아파트(연립주택) 매매가격도 올해 들어 누적으로 3.37%(5월 기준) 오르며 지난해 5월 누적 상승률(0.59%)의 6배에 가까운 상승폭을 보이고 있다.)
